# Luciano Longo — Digital Philology

> Academic portfolio of Luciano Longo, independent researcher in digital philology,
> textual criticism, genetic criticism and TEI/XML scholarly digital editing.
> The site is bilingual (English and Italian).

## Site
- [Entry / language selector](https://luciano-longo77.github.io/): bilingual landing page linking to the English and Italian versions.
- [Portfolio (English)](https://luciano-longo77.github.io/en/): full site in English — about, research, publications, activities, contacts.
- [Portfolio (Italiano)](https://luciano-longo77.github.io/it/): full site in Italian.
